description: Machine-readable Frontend LEGO migration inventory for Issue #241. References surfaces declared in manifest/surfaces.json (not a second surface catalog). Migration status tracks the strangler journey of each UI surface; it is not the capability runtime lifecycle and not backend capabilityMigrationState.

entries.title: Application shell and navigation
entries.notes: P2-S13 Layer 3 strangler slice (issue #240): the primary navigation, breadcrumbs and route-switching shell. The route table and the active route are handed over (the surface never fetches a route table, never reads window.location and issues no route change - the app-layer router owns history), the four region states reuse REGION_STATES, a filter to zero is empty with reason filtered rather than a fifth state, and a path carrying secret query material is refused with an explicit security error. One low-risk surface, mode pilot, rollback pilot-not-primary; the original editor stays the default path.

entries.title: Workflow list / dashboard overview
entries.notes: Dashboard already declares empty-states and notification hooks in surfaces.json.

entries.title: Workflow editor host
entries.notes: P2-S08 Layer 3 strangler slice (issue #240): the editor HOST header and workflow-level actions panel around the canvas (name/tags/active-state). The workflow record is handed over read-only and never mutated - rename/activate are declared interactions with explicit results. The canvas/editor rewrite itself stays OUT of scope (ui.editor.canvas reference-only, issue #241 exclusion preserved). Bounded tag chips, closed vocabularies, REGION_STATES reused. One low-risk surface, mode pilot, rollback pilot-not-primary; the original editor stays the default path.

entries.title: Workflow canvas (nodes, connections)
entries.notes: P2-S14 Layer 3 strangler slice (issue #240): the workflow node-graph rendering surface (nodes, edges, viewport, selection), the composite region of the workflow editor delivered as its own slice. The graph model is handed over (the surface never fetches a graph and performs no engine call - selection and zoom are declared view-state interactions with closed result vocabularies, never graph mutations), the four region states reuse REGION_STATES, and a payload carrying secret or engine fields is refused with an explicit security error. One low-risk surface, mode pilot, rollback pilot-not-primary; the original editor stays the default path.

entries.title: Node picker / catalog (palette, search)
entries.notes: P2-S07 Layer 3 strangler slice (issue #240). A bounded, query-filterable view-model of the node picker palette: node types are handed over (the surface never fetches /rest/types/nodes.json, so it holds no private path to the node catalog), the four region states reuse REGION_STATES, filtering to zero is empty with reason filtered rather than a fifth state, and selecting a node type is a declared interaction returning a closed result vocabulary. Backend node-registry capability remains authoritative for node types. One low-risk surface, mode pilot, rollback pilot-not-primary; the original editor stays the default path.

entries.title: Node parameter / NDV panel
entries.notes: P2-S15 Layer 3 strangler slice (issue #240): the node parameter / NDV panel editing one node type's parameters through the parameter contract. Parameter definitions and values are handed over (the surface never fetches a schema and evaluates no expression - strings pass through verbatim behind the declared boundary - and never posts the workflow), the four region states reuse REGION_STATES, and the parameter type vocabulary is the declared subset string|number|boolean|options. One low-risk surface, mode pilot, rollback pilot-not-primary; the original editor stays the default path. P7 dynamic parameters remain non-scope (Issue #241 non-scope).

entries.title: Execution list, detail and errors
entries.notes: P2-S03 Layer 3, third strangler slice. A bounded, status-filterable view-model of the executions page list: rows are handed over (the surface never fetches /rest/executions, so it holds no private path to the execution catalog), the four region states reuse REGION_STATES, filtering to zero is `empty` with reason `filtered` rather than a fifth state, and opening an execution is a declared interaction never executed. Execution engine authority stays backend-side; UI only declares/requests/renders. One low-risk surface, mode pilot, rollback pilot-not-primary; the original editor stays the default path.

entries.title: Credentials list and editor
entries.notes: P2-S09 Layer 3/4 strangler slice (issue #240): the credentials LIST view-model (bounded, visibility-filterable) plus create/delete/sharing affordances as declared interactions. Credential values never reach the surface - the row shape carries identity metadata only and a value-bearing row is refused explicitly; the value-entry editor, the P5/P2.27 envelope and the credential runtime stay out of this slice. Credential security boundary is P5 (Agent 1) — finding-only, never modified here. One low-risk surface, mode pilot, rollback pilot-not-primary; the original editor stays the default path.

entries.title: Settings pages
entries.notes: P2-S10 Layer 3/4 strangler slice (issue #240): the settings PANELS view-model (instance + personal), bounded and panel-switchable. Settings values are handed over through declared settings capabilities only; an entry carrying a secret-bearing field is refused with an explicit security error (P2.27/P5 secret boundary is finding-only here) and the surface never mutates settings data - save/reset are declared interactions with a closed result vocabulary. Localization and theme stay later authorized slices. Mode pilot, rollback pilot-not-primary; the original editor stays the default path.

entries.title: Webhook URL/method/registration surface (shown with a node or workflow)
entries.notes: P2-S11 Layer 3/4 strangler slice (issue #240): the webhook URL/method/registration surface shown with a node or a workflow, bounded and resource-switchable. Registrations are handed over through declared capabilities only; the surface ISSUES NO REGISTER CALL and a registration carrying auth material is refused with an explicit security error (Webhook node + Credentials runtime own auth, finding-only here). Mode pilot, rollback pilot-not-primary; the original editor stays the default path.

entries.title: Auth surface (sign-in, user management and membership)
entries.notes: P2-S12 Layer 4 strangler slice (issue #240): the sign-in, user-management and membership surface, bounded and facet-switchable (signin / users / membership). Identity state and the directory are handed over by the auth capability in one loadSuccess payload; the surface ISSUES NO LOGIN CALL, never re-derives identity locally and refuses credential or session material with an explicit security error (the auth runtime owns verification, finding-only here). The owner role change answers owner-unchangeable per the reference n8n rule. Mode pilot, rollback pilot-not-primary; the original editor stays the default path.

entries.title: Projects / workspace surfaces
entries.notes: No dedicated surfaces.json row yet; navigation/dashboard host project entry points.

entries.title: Workflow import / export
entries.notes: Workflow JSON semantics remain compatibility-critical (#240 invariant).

entries.title: AI assistant / copilot surfaces
entries.notes: Declared capability rows exist (ai-assistant/ai-copilot) but are not installed; no second AI authority.

entries.title: Localization presentation layer
entries.notes: Message-slot grammar and locale model already live in i18n.mjs + localization contract; translation capability remains declared-only.

entries.title: Loading / empty / error status primitives
entries.notes: Issue #241 pilot: framework-neutral status region behind the existing registry/extension seam; original UI stays primary.

entries.title: Accessibility shared primitives
entries.notes: ui:accessibility:annotate stays attribute-only; no layout authority moves into LEGO.

entries.title: Shared notification surface (toast / banner / inline)
entries.notes: Issue #245. Severity (info/success/warning/error) and disposition (shown/dismissed) are separate axes from the region state the parity harness compares: the contract reuses REGION_STATES rather than forking a second list. Dismissal removes the notice from the live region instead of adding a sixth region state, because a dismissed notice that still occupied a region would still be announced. Only `error` is aria-live assertive; `warning` stays polite so cautions do not train users to ignore the region. The queue is bounded and errors are never silently dropped. Opt-in and non-primary: the stock n8n notification presentation remains the default path.

entries.title: Connection inspector / connection list
entries.notes: P2-S16 Layer 3 strangler slice (issue #240): the connection inspector / connection list managing a workflow's connections. Connection records and the node-id vocabulary are handed over (the surface never fetches a graph, issues no engine call and never writes the workflow - selection is view state, reconnect and remove are declared requests with closed result vocabularies), the four region states reuse REGION_STATES, and the connection type vocabulary is the declared subset main|ai_tool|ai_memory|ai_embedding|ai_vector. One low-risk surface, mode pilot, rollback pilot-not-primary; the original editor stays the default path.

entries.title: Dashboard workflow list (loading / empty / error / ready, bounded + filterable)
entries.notes: P2-S03 Layer 3, first strangler slice. A bounded, client-filtered view-model of the Home workflow list: rows are handed over (the surface never fetches, so it holds no private path to the workflow catalog), the four region states reuse REGION_STATES, filtering to zero is `empty` with reason `filtered` rather than a fifth state, and opening/toggling a workflow are declared interactions never executed. One low-risk surface, mode pilot, rollback pilot-not-primary; the original editor stays the default path.

entries.title: Dialogs / overlays (handed-over content, bounded, declared actions by kind)
entries.notes: P2-S03 Layer 3, second strangler slice (P2-S05). A bounded view-model for modals/overlays: the content is handed over (the surface never fetches, so it holds no private data path to the content's owning capability), the four region states reuse REGION_STATES, a closed dialog is `empty` not a fifth state, and the kind (confirmation/form/notice) decides the declared ready actions. One low-risk surface, mode pilot, rollback pilot-not-primary; the original editor stays the default path.
